The Lifetime MyoLift™ QT comes with all premium app features for an unlimited amount of time. 

Lifetime App Features: My plan, live webinars, customer support & app free mode,rewards, custom sessions, 1:1 esthetician connect & Ai skin analysis

settings.title: What is microcurrent technology?
settings.text:
The Myolift QT Plus is an advanced facial toning device. When we observed the common set of problems that consumers face, it drove us to create a comprehensive solution. People were struggling to understand the complexities of microcurrent devices such as battery life, discomfort during usage,
maintenance, and conductivity. Considering all of these, we developed a face toning device that not only eliminates all these problems but also enhances
your skin in the most rejuvenating and comprehensive manner.


The power of microcurrent technology

Dual mode magic

The Myolift™ QT device utilizes two primary microcurrent modes, Stretch and Lift. The ‘Stretch’ mode helps to soften all those
fine lines, crow’s feet, and smile lines that you are afraid of seeing every time you have a deep glance into your face.

The ‘Lift’ mode helps to lift and tone your sagging and droopy facial muscles. It functions like a workout for your facial muscles.

Smart App integration

This feature is the most user-friendly because of its smooth integration with the QT Plus app which enhances the overall personalized experience of microcurrent
skincare.

Seamless Connectivity

The Myolift QT Plus App connects to your mobile phone via Bluetooth, providing better control and many customizable treatment options.

Guided treatments

We have easy-to-understand tutorials and guided treatment programs that include pre-set programs for various skin concerns and goals.

Track progress

It feels good to see how far you have come. On the Myolift  QT Plus app, the user can track their treatment progress over time, noting improvements in their skin texture, firmness, and overall appearance.

Advanced features of Myolift™ QT face toning device

Conductive gloves

Conductive gloves are designed to provide a 
targeted facial treatment. These conductive gloves can only work with a Myolift face toning device. These gloves help cover larger areas on the face more effectively and help  to isolate the area you're working on.

Rechargeable battery 

This is an essential feature provided by Myolift face toning devices which enables
seamless portability, long-lasting battery life, and multiple sessions on a single charge. Along with being convenient, this feature is also eco-friendly.

Can we use the Myolift QT Plus face toning device with other skincare products?

Yes, you can!

Products such as serums and gels deliver potent ingredients deep into the skin, specifically addressing skin concerns such as 
irregular skin texture, wrinkles, fine lines, and puffiness. The overall
effect is enhanced significantly due to microcurrent therapy as it increases skin permeability for the product to work. Also, the facial toning device makes sure the products are evenly covered in each part of the skin. 

Is the Myolift QT PLUS facial toning device safe to use?

Designed to ensure minimal to zero risk during usage, the Myolift face toning device
offers comprehensive features that assure risk-free usage. The Myolift™ QT is
an FDA cleared device.

Low-level microcurrent

The Myolift QT facial toning device uses a low-level electric current that mimics
the body’s natural electrical signals and is completely non-invasive. Users can change the intensity of the  current according to their comfort level.

 The reward system of Myolift QT Plus App

The Myolift QT Plus App rewards you as you progress your skincare journey. It
rewards your consistency and progress of completing sessions.

Features of the rewards

Points Accumulations

Earn points for treatments

Users can earn points for each completed treatment session. The app tracks the
duration and intensity of each session, awarding points accordingly. Consistent
use of Myolift QT PLUS facial toning device can increase bonus points, encouraging users to maintain regular skincare.

Users can earn additional points by referring the Myolift QT Plus face toning device
to friends and family.
